skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: Deliverables must be at the task root — the host stages the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`) to `/app/` in the container. Place output files directly in the task root (e.g., `tasks/<id>/report.json`), NOT in `solution/`, `output/`, or on t...

Output path must match test's OUTPUT_FILE path — always check `test_outputs.py` for the exact path the test reads (e.g., `OUTPUT_FILE = "openipf_output.xlsx"` relative to CWD). The host stages the task directory to `/app/` and runs tests...

Solution script output path — don't confuse the Dockerfile input mount point (e.g., `/root/data/`) with the test output path. The solution reads input from the Dockerfile mount but MUST write output to the path `test_outputs.py` imports.
